newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel to raise value of Buba assets - German paper.
newsitem.headline: Waigel to raise value of Buba assets - German paper.

text.p: German finance minister Theo Waigel is seeking a higher valuation of Bundesbank assets in a bid to raise further cash for Bonn's budget coffers, the Berliner Zeitung newspaper reported.

In a release issued ahead of publication in Friday's edition, the newspaper reported that the Bonn government was urging Bonn to put a higher book value on its dollar, foreign currency and gold assets to boost the central bank's profits.
The Bundesbank currently books its assets at their all-time lowest price, a method which is normal under German book-keeping regulations.
The Berliner Zeitung said that the revaluation would result in a profit in the "two digit billions of marks".
It said the issue was being discussed at today's central bank council meeting.
A Bundesbank spokesman declined comment on the agenda for the meeting, which is kept secret.
The Bundesbank earlier declined comment on a similar report carried in the Handelsblatt newspaper.
